10 of 12 club badges sourced live from TheSportsDB's 'Swiss Super League' team list. That list did not include BSC Young Boys or FC Zürich (two of the league's biggest, most-followed clubs — a real gap in that source, not a lookup mistake); both have a real official crest on Wikimedia Commons and are used from there instead (BSC Young Boys logo.svg; FC Zurich Logo 2022.svg, the club's current 2022-adopted crest).

No Swiss Super Cup entry: the competition existed 1986-1990 only and has not been revived since (per en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swiss_Super_Cup) — omitted per instructions rather than fabricated, same policy as Norway's missing super cup elsewhere in this dataset.
